review_text: My friends got hot latte. They said it wasn't that bitter and it was good. I got their special meaty clubhouse sandwich and it was actually good. It's good for sharing, at least 2-3 people. Their matcha drink was okay. It wasn't mixed properly but I understand. The prices of the food were fine, considering the place. So-so, I guess. The place is pretty nice. It has charging slots and free wifi. Your stay doesn't have a time limit. This is perfect for those who wants to study or work silently. The place has a good lighting. However, it seems to be hot that day. I am not certain if their aircon's temperature was just low or if it was under maintenance. Their staff were really nice. They were very approachable and friendly. They clean the tables once in a while. Overall, I like the Cafe and I will be coming back to taste more from their menu and also to study peacefully, hihi :)

place_name: The Coffee Bar at GMall of Davao
review_text: Today me and friends decided to visit this new café in Gensan, The Coffee Bar, it was our first time and our experience was disappointing. First, the cashier S****** told us that the serving time of our orders, iced matcha latte and iced caramel latte will take 1 hour and 30 mins, we were confused why but we chose to understand so we did not really mind it. Second, the cashier was somewhat unprofessional for slamming my credit card and receipt. Third, my iced matcha latte had hair inside. Lastly, when I asked her before we left if she found any Uniqlo paper bag, she told me no but the other staff took the initiative to check if they had kept it. Luckily, it was given back to me and when she saw me with the paper bag, she simply ignored me. It is just disappointing how some staff treat young customers poorly compared to those that are older. For the food and drinks, it is far different from their Davao branch. I hope your service and food quality will improve.
